title: Unification and Optimization of Robust Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.28165v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Robust learning methods such as distributionally robust optimization, vicinal risk minimization, Mixup, and label smoothing address different sources of uncertainty, including distribution shift, finite-sample effects, and label uncertainty. In practice, however, several such sources may occur simultaneously, and it remains unclear which robust method or combination of methods to use. We introduce a unified framework that organizes a broad class of robustness methods along explicit design axes and makes their relations and combinations explicit within a shared formulation. Within this framework, we analyze how robustness methods interact: some are redundant under particular modeling assumptions, whereas others yield genuinely distinct solution families, and these relationships can change with the model class or loss. We further derive a tractable training procedure that exposes the design choices and their strengths as tunable hyperp

translated_title: 鲁棒监督学习的统一与优化
translated_abstract: 鲁棒学习方法，如分布鲁棒优化、邻域风险最小化、Mixup和标签平滑，分别应对不同的不确定性来源，包括分布偏移、有限样本效应和标签不确定性。然而在实践中，多种不确定性来源可能同时出现，目前尚不清楚应选用哪种鲁棒方法或方法组合。我们提出了一个统一框架，将一大类鲁棒性方法沿着明确的设计维度进行组织，并在共享的表述中清晰地展现它们之间的关系与组合方式。在该框架内，我们分析了鲁棒方法之间的相互作用：某些方法在特定建模假设下是冗余的，而另一些方法则产生真正不同的解族，且这些关系会随模型类或损失函数的变化而改变。我们进一步推导出一种可操作的训练过程，将设计选择及其优势转化为可调节的超参数。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一框架，将分布鲁棒优化、Mixup、标签平滑等鲁棒学习方法纳入同一表述体系，明确了各方法间的冗余或互补关系，并推导出将设计选择转化为可调超参数的实用训练过程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified framework that organizes diverse robust supervised learning methods within a shared formulation, characterizes when these methods are redundant or complementary, and derives a tractable training procedure that turns design choices into tunable hyperparameters.
